{
  "dataset_name": "electricity",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "price_spread",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between NSW and VIC electricity prices, capturing inter-regional price divergence as a continuous signal",
      "value_range": [-0.22, 0.97],
      "feature_family": "price_differential",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear separator on price divergence between regions; large spreads may indicate directional price movement",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswprice - vicprice"
    },
    {
      "name": "price_ratio_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log ratio of NSW to VIC price plus small epsilon to handle zeros, capturing relative price magnitude on log scale",
      "value_range": [-3.5, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "price_differential",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log-transformed ratio provides smooth continuous feature for linear margins on multiplicative price relationships",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(nswprice) - np.log1p(vicprice)"
    },
    {
      "name": "demand_imbalance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized difference between NSW and VIC demand, measuring inter-regional demand imbalance",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 0.88],
      "feature_family": "demand_differential",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous demand imbalance score useful as linear feature for predicting price direction",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(nswdemand - vicdemand) / (nswdemand + vicdemand + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_demand",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of NSW and VIC demand as a proxy for total grid load",
      "value_range": [0.03, 1.91],
      "feature_family": "demand_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Total system load is a smooth continuous feature that linearly relates to price pressure",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswdemand + vicdemand"
    },
    {
      "name": "transfer_demand_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of inter-regional transfer to total demand, indicating how much of demand is met by transfers",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "transfer_efficiency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Transfer-to-demand ratio captures grid stress and is a smooth ratio feature for linear models",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "transfer / (nswdemand + vicdemand + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "period_sin",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sine transformation of period to capture cyclical intraday patterns on a smooth continuous scale",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_cyclical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth sinusoidal encoding of time-of-day enables linear models to capture periodic demand/price patterns",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sin(2 * 3.14159265 * period)"
    },
    {
      "name": "period_cos",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cosine transformation of period to capture cyclical intraday patterns orthogonal to sine component",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_cyclical",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Orthogonal cosine encoding complements sine feature for full circular time representation in linear models",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.cos(2 * 3.14159265 * period)"
    },
    {
      "name": "price_demand_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of NSW price and NSW demand as an approximate revenue or market stress indicator",
      "value_range": [0.0, 0.88],
      "feature_family": "price_demand_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Interaction term approximates market value flow; useful linear projection for SVM margin separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "nswprice * nswdemand"
    },
    {
      "name": "transfer_price_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of transfer and NSW price deviation from mean, capturing combined transfer and price signal",
      "value_range": [-0.12, 0.85],
      "feature_family": "transfer_price_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite weighted feature provides approximate linear projection combining transfer flow and price level",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.6 * transfer + 0.4 * np.clip(nswprice - 0.05977, -0.5, 0.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_demand_period_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Smooth score combining high demand and peak period indicators, normalized to 0-1 range",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demand_temporal_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Continuous composite score for peak demand conditions useful as smooth linear feature",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((nswdemand - 0.2) / 0.7, 0.0, 1.0) * np.clip((period - 0.2) / 0.6, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vic_price_severity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic severity score for VIC price level: 0 indicates very low VIC price (near zero), 1 indicates extremely high VIC price spike; assessed based on how far vicprice deviates from its typical low range",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "price_severity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized severity score for VIC price spikes provides smooth continuous signal for linear SVM margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "grid_stress_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Composite semantic index from 0 to 1 assessing overall grid stress based on combined signals of high demand in both regions, elevated prices, and transfer levels relative to typical operating ranges",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "grid_stress_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Holistic grid stress score as a single smooth continuous feature enables linear models to capture complex multi-variable stress conditions",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
